subject: Launch readiness: roles, eval runs & access playbook
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rao <maya@celerity.ai>, Oliver Brooks <oliver.b@celerity.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Launch readiness: roles, eval runs & access playbook

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and a proposed playbook to get the 30-day evaluation running next week. I captured the pain, the measurable goals, and immediate access items so we can move quickly. Please reply with any corrections or missing owners.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: Long-tail response hallucinations in customer-facing snippets and high token cost during peak queries (batching is inconsistent).
- Primary goal: Reduce hallucination rate below 3% on the top-50 prompts and keep median inference latency < 250ms for 1-2k qps profile.
- Secondary: Validate prompt-rewrite heuristics and measure cost delta with 4-bit quantized model.

30-day evaluation scope (proposed)
- Test window: 30 days, two phases: (1) baseline eval runs on historical prompts, (2) staged A/B with Redwood routing + caching enabled.
- Success metrics: top-50 prompt F1/precision on reference labels, hallucination rate, median/95p latency, tokens-per-session cost.
- Deliverables: weekly eval reports, final runbook with quantization recommendation and batching profile.

Owners & roles (initial)
- Celerity: Maya Rao (product lead) — data access + evaluation acceptance; Oliver Brooks — infra contact for temporary S3 access.
- Redwood: David Kim (AM, overall), Ben Carter (CS lead — onboarding & prompt-eval harness), Marissa Cole (SRE liaison — infra & networking).

Access & setup checklist (immediate asks)
- Celerity provides: dev S3 read-only bundle (sample + labels) and a short allowlist of internal test IPs. See sample link you mentioned.
- Redwood provides: credentials template (attached), temporary sandbox model endpoint, and a pre-configured prompt suite template (attached).
- Timing: aim to complete access & baseline run within 5 business days after S3 access is granted.

Attachments: eval_scope.pdf (scope + metrics), prompt_suite.csv (seed prompts + labels), credentials_template.txt (access format).

Proposed next steps (week of Dec 20)
1) Maya/Oliver grant S3 read-only access and a point-of-contact for infra (expected by Dec 17).
2) Ben to spin up sandbox endpoint + run baseline eval (2–3 days).
3) Joint checkpoint call after baseline (share early metrics and any blocking infra work).

If that all looks good I can loop in our legal/finance contacts for the short-term PO and a DocuSign for the standard evaluation SOW.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: eval_scope.pdf (22KB), prompt_suite.csv (12KB), credentials_template.txt (1KB)

Subject: Re: Launch readiness: roles, eval runs & access playbook

Thanks David — this looks good and captures our asks. A couple clarifications from our side:

- S3 sample: we'll publish the read-only bundle (anonymized) by EOD Wed (Dec 15). Link will be s3://celerity-samples/personalization-sample-v2.tar.gz.
- Data retention/compliance: the dataset contains PII placeholders; we need Redwood to confirm log retention window for the sandbox (30 days max) and to disable long-term debug dumps.
- Contracting: legal prefers a short evaluation addendum rather than a full SOW for 30-day trials. If you can send that via DocuSign we can pick up signatures quickly.

Oliver will be the infra owner and will coordinate the ACLs. We're aligned on the success metrics — curious if Redwood has an out-of-the-box hallucination detection heuristic you recommend for the baseline.

Ben / Marissa — looping you both in to start operational work. Key asks from Celerity: S3 read access for the sample bundle, 30-day sandbox retention, and an initial baseline eval on the attached prompt set.

Ben — can you confirm ETA to provision a sandbox endpoint and run the baseline eval (baseline run config attached in eval_scope.pdf)? Aim: baseline run + first-pass hallucination report within 48–72 hours of access. Note the target latency budget (median <250ms).

Marissa — we'll likely need a short NAT rule for Oliver's ingress IPs and a temporary allowlist for our sandbox. I'll share the credentials_template.txt for Celerity to populate.

Maya / Oliver — once Ben confirms the sandbox ETA we'll schedule the checkpoint call. Also pushing a DocuSign addendum link to streamline contracting (link below).

On it — provisioning sandbox now. Quick status & next steps from ops: 

1) Sandbox endpoint: will be ready by Thu 16 Dec 09:00 PST. I will share endpoint, temp API key, and a short runbook.
2) Baseline eval: I'll kick off the baseline run on Thursday and expect first-pass metrics by Friday EOD. We'll include the hallucination heuristic (n-gram overlap + model-confidence threshold) as a first filter, then sample manual review for edge cases.
3) Retention & logging: sandbox logs will be kept 30 days (agreed), debug dumps disabled by default. If Celerity needs extended retention we can discuss an enterprise logging add-on.
4) Networking: Marissa — can you confirm when you can add Oliver's IPs to the allowlist?

Maya — please share the S3 link when available and populate the credentials_template.txt so we can validate access.

I'll post the endpoint details and the initial run artifacts into the HubSpot deal record and share the run artifacts link after the baseline completes.

Ben Carter
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
